items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Chinese was a good drummer... I used to have to go like the devil and get somebody... I kept him when I got him.

ctx.x: Well, Chinese was with the tuxedo.
Chinese was a good drummer, but Chinese would get high like that and mess you up, man.
Did Paul Barber never play with you? Well, yeah.
